tests.assertion: test('4875/1268真实击败请求接续当前敌已复活的下回合前态，仅限定三种各独立2或3回合，无放回且免异失败不补抽',()=>{const durations=new Map(['烧伤','冻伤','中毒'].map(k=>[k,new Set()]));for(const immune of[0,1])for(let seed=1;seed<=20;seed++){const s=make({...row(1268),targetHp:1,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750);/* Explicit fixture: same current target has returned alive before next round; no claim to implement its revival. */s.finished=false;s.winner=null;s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=immune;s.fighters[1].soulState.deathResolved=false;turn(s,38282);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750,undefined);const ailments=s.fighters[1].ailments;assert.equal(Object.keys(ailments).length,3-immune);for(const[k,end]of Object.entries(ailments)){assert.ok(durations.has(k));const n=end-2+1;assert.ok([2,3].includes(n));durations.get(k).add(n);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}for(const set of durations.values())assert.deepEqual(set,new Set([2,3]));});
